sec: sec:D001: Prevent hallucinated outputs / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:D001: Prevent hallucinated outputs / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing factual accuracy controls. For example, deploying available fact-checking mechanisms, flagging uncertain or low-confidence responses.
